aperture.affectedRadii: Exactly +r or -r on the planar stop; +/-1e-10 and +/-1e-7 relative offsets agree
aperture.reason: Upstream Aperture inherits Plane.intersect with r^2 strict comparison; Core circular physical aperture includes boundary with numerical tolerance.

criticalNear.attribution: Temporarily setting only upstream base module EPSILON=0 reduces the gradient discrepancy greatly. This controlled output is not the baseline. Residual is consistent with ill conditioning/roundoff; not claimed bit equality.

criticalExact.upstream: Original baseline produced finite stabilized outputs and gradients in this case.
criticalExact.csharp: CPU and CUDA reject the singular derivative for a batch containing the critical ray. One affected ray can make the fixed-input request fail.
criticalExact.scope: Physical/AD domain policy difference; not changed or treated as agreement.

tolerances.normalization: abs(actual-reference)/max(1,abs(reference)); specified in the probe before the final measurements
tolerances.scaledGradient: abs(gradient error)*characteristic parameter scale: axial/conic/nd=1, curvature=1/max(1,r), ai=1/max(1,r)^order, V=50. Distinct units require scaled or relative interpretation.
